notes.title: Moviehouse Patch version 1.6.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Movie-Fans,
as promised in our recently released Content Roadmap, another big patch is live now, bringing lots of additions, including even an earlier start date: the 1960s, new research options, new improvements, and some fixes, and more! 
Find below the full changelog the Content Roadmap, to get excited, what comes next! 

New Features
The New Hollywood
 New 1960 start date with new visuals, can be selected from the main menu (recommended after playing the 1980s start date)
 Two new research options:
 Risqueness - walk the tight rope between appealing to the new age of cinema or the old studio machine
 Studio meddling - you're in charge! Decide how much control you will exert on the production
 Added four new thematic character avatars (9 variations)
 Added three new thematic movie production events
 Added twelve new thematic plot cards

Changes and improvements
 Improved balancing for self-distribution, turning a profit in the early game should be significantly easier when distributing good movies
 Reduced the profit gained from investments to improve mid to late game balance
 Movie traits are now displayed in the movie card


Thank you for your ongoing support! Please keep it up!
-Your teams of Odyssey Studios & Assemble Entertainment-

notes.title: Moviehouse Patch version 1.5.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Movie-Fans,
as promised in our recently released Content Roadmap, another big patch is live now, bringing lots of additions (like new studio boss system), a lot of improvements, and some fixes! 
Find below the full changelog the Content Roadmap, to get excited, what comes next! 

Changes
 Improved clarity when making decisions
 Redesigned movie list overview to give access to all available data about a film, including budget, plot and used set information
 Implemented tooltip with the previously mentioned changes during important decisions such as the film festival trivia prompt and during production to give the player all the necessary information to make their decision
 Updated Back Catalogue to show unreleased movies
 New studio boss system, the player can now select their character archetype when designing their studio
 The Director – the base game remains unchanged
 The Patron – a more difficult experience for those who want to make fine art
 The Exec – run a tight ship, squash any unnecessary artistic freedom in exchange for loads of cash
 Mogul – all costs, penalties and requirements are increased, good luck, director!
 UI improvements
 Increased small text sizes to increase visibility
 Adjusted UI elements to fit the new larger text sizes
 Tutorial revamp
 Redesigned tutorial 
 Added explanatory images to tutorial steps
 Added new tutorial steps to better clarify features
 Rewrote existing tutorial steps for better clarity
 Revamped the distribution system
 Swapped self distribution and studio distribution as first available distribution method
 Rewrote the self distribution profit calculation to better take into account the movies quality and generated buzz
 Implemented «Buzz Reach» to better communicate how popular the movie is and to allow the player to make the appropriate choices regarding it’s marketing
 Implemented three new research options for self distribution to better guide the player through the process
 Poster Studio
 Movie Trailers
 Marketing Campaigns
 General performance improvements
 Increased employee exhaustion gain rate

Fixes
 Resolved issue where the player would not be able to continue the game past year 41 after the end screen
 Taking the money upfront distribution deal now tallies the gained income to the total profits made by the film
 Fixed exhaustion not being counted towards the employees total happiness in the happiness indicator
 Fixed the player being able to spend more then the money they have when selecting the budget for a blockbuster

Content Roadmap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40260075/dc6cb33c537f44c7dbf704379374f3e75520398b.png


Stay tuned and thank you for your ongoing support! please keep it up!
-Your teams of Odyssey Studios & Assemble Entertainment-

notes.title: Moviehouse | Patch #2 | Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Movie-Fans,
The second Patch for Moviehouse is live now, bringing improved readability and other adjustments, as well as some fixes. This is the second patch based on the great feedback we got from lots of you! We are currently in the process of evaluating the next steps and will communicate a plan for further improvements soon.

Changes

 Updated UI elements to improve readability on smaller screens

 Text sizes should be larger across the game
 Increased plot card size in the card deck overview to double the card size
 NOTE: It's possible to adjust the UI scale in the settings, while this is an experimental feature and the UI can overlap in places on higher UI scales, it can help with accessibility. With that said, we'll be keeping an eye out on possible accessibility improvements as we go.

 Slightly increased complexity requirement for productions
 Increased difficulty of gaining profit from low quality movies, the penalty increases depending on production size, with Blockbusters having the highest penalty
 Reduced research point gain, previously research point gain increased with higher movie craft & creativity, the upper scale has been adjusted to even out the point gain in the later game


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where the player was shown matching plot cards as not matching if the player had previously made a movie where the card didn't match
 Fixed loan repayment notification, staying even after loan has been repaid
 Fixed issue where media types would produce far too much profit given their customer base (Videotape, Video Discs), these distributions should now produce a slight secondary source of profit with the trade of having to use up a distribution slot as intended.

notes.title: Moviehouse | Patch #1 | Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Movie-Fans,
The first Patch for Moviehouse is live now, bringing performance improvements and Balancing changes, as well as working achievements. This is the first patch based on the great feedback we got from lots of you! We are currently in the process of evaluating the next steps and will communicate a plan for further improvements soon.

Changes & Improvements

 Re-balanced the "Self Distribution" buzz requirement. This should make the self-distribution method more worthwhile, even in the early game.
 The "Self Distribution" research is now available earlier, and for "Indie" studios, reduced the research cost from 4 to 2 points.
 Changed "Any Genre" research name to "New Genre" to add clarity
 Increased employee exhaustion gain to make it to balance the need of maintaining your employees' happiness.


Bug Fixes

 General performance improvements

 Performance should be better in general, but we can't promise a massive increase for everyone, as we're still investigating the reported cases.
 Some users with edge cases, where the performance was show-stopping, have reported three to four times improvement.
 More performance improvements to follow!

 Steam achievements are now rewarded accordingly!

 NOTE: While the achievement indicator does appear in the game, it is currently offset. This has more to do with how Steam integrates with the game, we're investigating.

 Fixed the same movies being shown in film festivals every year.

notes.title: Lights, Camera, Action! Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon is Out Now!
notes.content:
Places, people, places! Filming starts today! 
We are excited to announce that Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon is here for Windows PC and MacOS. A classic premise brought to the modern day with incredible detail, Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon lets you produce, and direct every aspect of whatever Hollywood blockbuster you can think of. 
You can get yourself even a sweet 10% off launch-discount here on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576280/Moviehouse__The_Film_Studio_Tycoon/?utm_source=ReleaseNews

Watch the Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon release trailer: 
[previewyoutube=DZKb2knl1es;full][/previewyoutube]


About Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon
Starting from humble beginnings, the goal of Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon is to create a film worthy of being shown in every theater across the world. Simple in theory, yet in-depth and challenging in execution. No one becomes a world renowned director overnight, so you’ll need to start with smaller projects and indie films. If successful, you’ll garner more attention, more praise, and most importantly, more money. More money means bigger productions, bigger productions mean more resources, which in turn leads to better movies.  

Those that have worked on a major production know one thing: the devil is in the details. So in keeping with that idea, Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon gives you absolute control over every last minute detail of your productions. Any seemingly small detail is yours to tweak to your liking. Budget on casting calls? Adjustable. Background shrubbery? Freely placeable. Early showing placements? Up to your keen eye for planning. The entirety of your set is at your fingertips.     

Features of Moviehouse - The Film Studio Tycoon
 That’s Showbiz, Baby!: Compete in the glamorous Industry Awards showcase, vying for multiple titles including best feature film, and set your sights on winning the coveted golden clapper
 The Tides of Change: As the decades pass, both your team and your equipment will improve. Starting off with a small amateur cast and rudimentary equipment, the studio and all those a part of it will mature and hone their skills, while new updates in technology and filming techniques grant the ability for better filmmaking! 
 Assemble the Dream Team: Hire directors and writers and build up their creative skills, nurturing their creative prowess. A good crew in itself can turn casual viewers into diehard fans!
 Hit the Festival Circuit: Showcase your movie in film festivals to build buzz, gain accolades, and garner critical success
 An Eye for Filmmaking: Make a spy flick, a romantic comedy, a bloody slasher, or something entirely different. You’ve got the film-making tools at your fingertips, so it’s all up to you!


Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon is available now for PC and Mac here on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576280/Moviehouse__The_Film_Studio_Tycoon/?utm_source=ReleaseNews

Today, together with indie dev Odyssey Studios we excitingly reveal an April 5, 2023, release date for Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon, a new film-making management tycoon that puts you in the director’s chair of an up-and-coming production studio. 
You will write, produce, and direct indies evolving into Hollywood’s biggest hits in this new spin on the classic tycoon formula.

Check out Moviehouse in the latest trailer:
[previewyoutube=jUBDAfv_jkw;full][/previewyoutube]


About Moviehouse
Showcased in the new devlog, Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon proves that the devil really is in the details, with the devs showcasing how they went about creating one of the most important yet vastly overlooked pieces of movie magic: the miniature set.

Starting in the 80s where neon and practical effects ruled, and spanning through the decades to the near-real look of current day CGI, players start with a small yet passionate film crew with rudimentary equipment who have one goal: grow the studio into one of the best in the industry and keep it that way for years to come. With an eye for entertainment, pick from a dozen popular film genres and plot the perfect, award-winning storyline. Grow your operation with your razor-sharp business sense and usher in a new era for filmmakers worldwide. You only get one shot to make it or break it, and as they say: if you film it, they will come!

notes.title: Welcome To The Party, Pal. - Assemble announces movie-Tycoon "Moviehouse"!
notes.content:
Here’s Johnny! - Together with the Latvian indie-game developer Odyssey Studios we are happy to announce our movie-tycoon game ‘Moviehouse’, for all movie enthusiasts out there, and those, who want to earn their star on the Hollywood Boulevard! 

Show me the money: Inspired by classics like ‚The Movies’ and ‘Game Dev Tycoon’ and releasing for Windows PC and MacOS (via Steam and GOG) you will be able to establish your very own movie studio, to produce your own movies and to make big money – may the force be with you!

For us, there is no spring, as this year’s Fall, we are going to make you an offer you can't refuse.

Are you not entertained? - In Moviehouse, you can decide, which movie-crew you want to hire, who will write the movies’ scripts, and so on. Additionally, you will create your own outstanding movie posters, produce the movies, and (hopefully) getting good movie critics and thus making the big money. – We love it when a plan comes together!

The Stuff That Dreams Are Made Of - In Moviehouse you will start with a small film-crew in the 80s, producing short-movies and climbing up the ladder of success, to finally produce blockbusters!

But with great power comes great responsibility: As movie mogul you not only have to take care about your movie production alone, but you also have to take care of the people and staff behind the production, as you will increase the skill of your employees with each new project. What’s normal anyways?

Watch the Moviehouse announcement trailer now!
[previewyoutube=RXx5vvoVOgU;full][/previewyoutube]

Features of Moviehouse
 What year is it?- Experience the decades and start with a small film crew in the 80s, develop your first short-film, compete, find success, and become one of the majors.
 I love making movies. - Make movies your way, as pick from a dozen different genres and plot the perfect storyline. Make a spy flick, a romantic comedy, or a bloody slasher or something entirely different. It’s all up to you.
 This is heavy! - Make your first blockbuster, a critically acclaimed arthouse film won’t always be a smash hit at the box office, nor will a costly movie always find a fan-base. It is up to you to strike the perfect balance to make a true blockbuster.
 It's Time To Join The Club - Assemble the dream team by hiring directors and writers and build up their skills. A good crew in itself can bring viewers to seats.
 We’re gonna make a fortune with this place. - Follow the times by honing your moviemaking craft and research new technologies to compete in an ever-changing market. Unlock sequels, prequels, cinematic universes and more.
 But you have heard of me. - Hit the festival circuit and showcase your movie in film festivals to build buzz, gain accolades and critical success!
 Life all comes down to a few moments. This is one of them. - Compete for the coveted golden clapper, as the Industry Awards are closing in. Has your movie been nominated? Compete in multiple categories, including best feature film, for a chance to win the golden clapper.

Moviehouse lets you live out your dream of finally making the perfect movie. Choose from up to twelve different genres, plot the storyline to your film and make a true blockbuster. Maybe it's time to start thinking about a cinematic universe?
